mapper.select: SELECT running_record_id, post_id, running_date, distance_km, duration_seconds, location_name, region, intensity, weather, created_at, updated_at FROM running_records WHERE post_id=#{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO running_records (post_id, running_date, distance_km, duration_seconds, location_name, region, intensity, weather, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{runningDate}, #{distanceKm}, #{durationSeconds}, #{locationName}, #{region}, #{intensity}, #{weather}, NOW(), NOW())
